title.narrative: Programa de Apoyo al Sector Transporte III
Support Program for the Transportation Sector III

description.narrative: La operacin propuesta constituye el tercer prstamo del BANCO al Programa de Apoyo al Sector Transporte y tiene por objetivo general contribuir a mejorar la eficiencia del transporte terrestre por carreteras en Nicaragua, a fin de estimular la actividad econmica y el bienestar de la poblacin y facilitar la intregracin de las diferentes regiones del pais con el resto de Centroamrica. Los objetivos especificos son: (i) reducir los costos de operacin vehicular, (ii) aumentar las velocidades de circulacin, (iii) reducir las interrupciones al trnsito, (iv) reducir la accidentalidad y (v) fomentar la conservacin del patrimonio vial.

The proposed operation is the third Bank loan to the Support Program to the Transportation Sector and aims to improve the overall efficiency of road transportation on roads in Nicaragua, in order to stimulate economic activity and welfare of the population and facilitate the intregracin of different regions of the country with the rest of Central America. The specific objectives are: (i) to reduce vehicle operating costs, (ii) to increase vehicle traffic speed, (iii) to minimize disruptions to traffic, (iv) to reduce the accident rate and (v) to encourage the preservation of road assets.
